title.rendered: TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment: Jobs for Freshers, Eligibility, Test Details, Salary Package, Deadline & How to Apply

content.rendered:
The TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment drive has been officially announced for fresh graduates and early professionals across India. Conducted by Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), the National Qualifier Test (NQT) is one of the largest fresher hiring assessments in the IT sector. The TCS NQT 2026 exam provides an entry pathway into Prime and Digital hiring categories with competitive salary packages and long-term career growth.

This article is based on official hiring details, verified eligibility requirements, and current campus recruitment trends. It covers everything students need to know about the TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment, including eligibility criteria, registration dates, salary packages, syllabus, and application steps. Candidates from AICTE/UGC-recognized institutions belonging to 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches can apply. For engineering and postgraduate students aiming to begin a career in IT and digital technologies, this recruitment drive offers a structured opportunity to join a leading global technology company.

TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment: Overview of Hiring for Freshers

The TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment is part of TCS All India hiring for freshers and early professionals. Through the tcs nqt exam, candidates can secure opportunities in Prime and Digital roles across various technology domains.

Key Highlights

  • Organization: Tata Consultancy Services
  • Hiring batches: 2024, 2025, 2026
  • Experience: 0–2 years
  • Hiring categories: Prime and Digital
  • Mode of test: In-centre
  • Official portal: TCS NextStep

The tcs nqt 2026 hiring process provides access to next-generation technology roles and career growth within TCS.

Eligibility Criteria for Applicants

Candidates applying for TCS NQT 2026 must meet specific academic and course requirements.

Eligible Degrees

AICTE/UGC recognized full-time courses:

  • B.Tech / B.E
  • M.Tech / M.E
  • MCA
  • M.Sc / M.S

Eligible Batches

  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026

Academic Requirements

Minimum 60% or equivalent CGPA in:

  • Class 10
  • Class 12
  • Diploma (if applicable)
  • Graduation
  • Post-Graduation (if applicable)

Additional conditions:

Degree must be completed within stipulated duration

No pending backlogs

Engineering must be completed in first class

These points form the core tcs nqt 2026 eligibility criteria for applicants.

Gap in Education and Other Conditions

Candidates applying for TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment must follow additional eligibility guidelines.

Gap in Education

  • Maximum 24 months academic gap allowed
  • Gap must be declared with supporting documents

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Only full-time courses eligible
  • Open schooling (NIOS) accepted for 10th/12th if graduation is full-time
  • Work experience up to 2 years allowed
  • Age limit: 18–28 years
  • Internship experience not considered for salary fitment

Registration Date and Important Schedule

Candidates must track the official timeline for TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment.

Important Dates

  • Registration Start Date: 18 February 2026
  • tcs nqt 2026 registration last date: 20 March 2026
  • Test Date: 10 March 2026 onwards

The tcs nqt 2026 registration date window allows candidates to apply and select preferred test centers. The tcs nqt 2026 march exam will be conducted across multiple centers.

Applicants should complete tcs nqt 2026 registration early to avoid last-minute issues.

Salary Package for Prime and Digital Roles

Candidates selected through TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment can receive job offers under Prime and Digital categories.

Prime & Digital Category Salary

UG Candidates (0–1 year): ₹9.09 LPA – ₹9.30 LPA

PG Candidates (0–1 year): ₹11.59 LPA – ₹11.80 LPA

UG Candidates (1–2 years): ₹9.45 LPA – ₹9.66 LPA

PG Candidates (1–2 years): ₹12.05 LPA – ₹12.26 LPA

Actual compensation may vary based on job role and location.

Syllabus and Test Pattern

The tcs nqt 2026 syllabus is designed to evaluate aptitude and technical skills.

Exam Sections

Quantitative aptitude

Logical reasoning

Verbal ability

Programming logic

Coding and technical skills

Candidates can select the skill track during tcs nqt registration. Preparation should focus on aptitude and basic programming concepts.

Off Campus Hiring Process

The tcs nqt 2026 off campus hiring process includes:

Online registration

National Qualifier Test

Technical interview

HR interview

Final selection and offer

Candidates shortlisted through the TCS NQT 2026 exam will be considered for Prime or Digital roles.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep all original academic documents ready
  • Communication will be sent via official TCS channels only
  • TCS does not charge money for jobs
  • Do not trust unofficial emails or agents
  • Eligibility will be checked at every stage

Step-by-Step Application Process

Step 1: Visit official tcs nqt 2026 link via NextStep portal
Step 2: Complete tcs nqt 2026 login or register as new user
Step 3: Click on “Apply for Drive”
Step 4: Select skill and preferred test centers
Step 5: Choose preferred job cities
Step 6: Check status under “Track Your Application”

Ensure the status shows “Applied for Drive”.

Why TCS NQT 2026 Is Important for Freshers?

The TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment offers an opportunity to start a career in one of the world’s leading IT companies. Selected candidates gain exposure to global projects, structured training, and long-term career growth.

The tcs nqt exam also provides:

  • Entry into high-growth IT roles
  • Competitive salary packages
  • Learning and mentorship programs
  • Nationwide hiring opportunities

For eligible engineering and postgraduate students, TCS NQT 2026 can be a major career launchpad.

Conclusion

The TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment drive provides a major opportunity for fresh graduates to secure high-quality IT jobs with competitive salaries and long-term career growth. With structured hiring, nationwide test centers, and entry into Prime and Digital roles, the TCS NQT 2026 exam is a significant pathway for engineering and postgraduate students. Eligible candidates should complete registration on time, prepare thoroughly, and follow official instructions carefully to maximize their chances of selection.

FAQ: TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment

Q1. Who can apply for TCS NQT 2026?

Students from B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, and M.Sc backgrounds from 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches can apply.

Q2. What is the TCS NQT 2026 registration last date?

The last date to apply for TCS NQT 2026 Recruitment is 20 March 2026.

Q3. What is the salary package offered?

Prime roles offer up to ₹12 LPA for PG candidates, while Digital roles offer up to ₹8 LPA.

Q4. How to apply for TCS NQT 2026?

Candidates must apply through the official tcs nextstep portal and complete registration and drive application.

Q5. Is TCS NQT 2026 off campus hiring?

Yes, it is an all-India tcs nqt 2026 off campus hiring drive for freshers and early professionals.
